# Native reformatting benchmark

Use the native surgical-editing interface for this task. Do not rebuild or
replace slides through HTML.

Reformat slides 2 through 8 as a coherent sequence:

- Change every native text element on these seven slides to use **Avenir Next**.
- Identify the title on each slide from the inspection data and the visual
  render. Right-align all seven titles.
- Give the titles one consistent typographic treatment and one consistent title
  box position and size wherever their content permits.
- If a title cannot use the common box without clipping or poor composition,
  make the smallest necessary exception and report it explicitly.
- Preserve all wording, body-text alignment, media, shapes, builds, comments,
  speaker notes, slide IDs, slide order, and every property unrelated to this
  request.

Inspect the seven slides first. Submit the complete change as one revision-bound
native preview batch. Visually compare every Before and After slide at 1920×1080,
fix every new or worsened overflow, and reject changes that damage the existing
composition. Apply once with the label `Agent: unify all-hands typography`, then
verify all seven slides in the real player.

In the final record, list the seven title element IDs, the shared title box and
typographic values, any exceptions, the preview draft ID, the applied revision,
and evidence that unrelated objects were preserved.
